[Gathered by ApprovalReady from official websites on 2026-10-12; a summary, not the source's wording] How to apply to City of Albany for a development application.
Planning scheme: City of Albany Local Planning Scheme No. 2.
Lodge (online): Submit the City's online development application form https://www.albany.wa.gov.au/forms/development-application-form/20
Lodge (email): Email the application form and attachments. Don't include card details; the City calls you to take payment planning@albany.wa.gov.au
Step 1: Check your property's zoning on the City's Property Map.
Step 2: Talk to the City's planning team before you lodge, or book a duty planner.
Step 3: Fill in the application form and the matching checklist. For advertising signs, see the City's Signs page.
Step 4: Lodge online or by email. If you email, the City calls you to take the fee by credit card.
Pre-lodgement meetings: offered (The City recommends talking to its planning team before you lodge. Book a duty planner online.).
Phone: (08) 6820 3000
Email: staff@albany.wa.gov.au
Address: 102 North Road, Yakamia WA 6330
Planning enquiries email: planning@albany.wa.gov.au
Planning enquiries phone: (08) 6820 3040

Planning scheme: City of Bayswater Local Planning Scheme No. 24.
Lodge (online): Lodge through the City's eProperty online lodgement portal https://bayswater-web.t1cloud.com/T1PRDefault/WebApps/eProperty/P1/GuestHome.aspx?r=P1.WEBGUEST&f=P1.EPR.GUESTHME.VIW
